Access.name: pdfDaGestireMoveBlobToNas
Access.Query:
select PDF_INSTANCE_ID from PDF_INSTANCE where PDF_CONTENT is not null and COMPLETION_TIME >= convert(varchar(8),
dataInizio,112) and COMPLETION_TIME < convert(varchar(8),dateadd(dd,+1,
dataFine),112)
